lines.en: I glide past the cliff face.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜在风里鼓起来。
lines.en: My wing membrane fills with wind.
I land on a branch and take off again.
I circle above the jungle.
I head for the ridge.
I drop low through a gap in the trees.
My long beak points ahead.
I glide for a while.
I start beating again.

lines.zh: 我借着上升气流滑了一圈。
lines.en: I ride the updraft in a wide circle.
I land on a rock.

lines.zh: 山风把我的翅膀托起来。
lines.en: The mountain wind lifts my wings.
I perch on the rock with wings folded.
The wind stirs my crest.

lines.zh: 我的喙尖有一点点缺口。
lines.en: There is a chip at my beak tip.

lines.zh: 我挂在崖壁上，翅尖收着。
lines.en: I cling to the cliff, wingtips folded.
Wings spread, one glide over the hills.

lines.zh: 我的翼尖轻轻抖了一下。
lines.en: My wing tip twitches.
I open them slightly.
This is high enough to see far.
I lower my head to preen.
The tropical wind is close.

lines.zh: 我从山壁边掠过，翼膜鼓满风。
lines.en: I sweep past the cliff, wing membranes full of wind.
The cry spreads through the trees.
My beak is full of fine teeth.
You are smaller than I am.
A feather still clings to my beak.
You climbed this high.
My wings spread wide.
Watch your footing.

lines.zh: 我还没决定要不要理你。
lines.en: I have not decided whether to bother with you.
The wind comes from your side.

lines.zh: 我从山地起飞，翅膀很薄。
lines.en: I lift from the hills on thin wings.

lines.zh: 山地上空，我这一声很尖。
lines.en: Above the mountains, my cry comes out sharp.
I flew crooked a while before leveling out.
I land to rest.
My wing bone aches from the hit.

lines.zh: 几根翼膜纤维挂了下来。
lines.en: A few wing fibers hang loose.

lines.zh: 我扑了两下翅膀才稳住。
lines.en: Two wingbeats steady me again.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，翅膀张开半截。
lines.en: I watch you, wings half-spread.

lines.zh: 翅膜破了个口，飞起来会晃。
lines.en: A tear in my wing — I'll wobble in flight.

lines.zh: 丛林里的猎物，今天轮到我挨打。
lines.en: Today the jungle's prey fights back.
I eat only what I catch myself.
Fruit doesn't even get a glance.

lines.zh: 你把东西放下，我再靠近。
lines.en: Put it down, and I will come closer.
This is too small to interest me.
I turn my head aside.
I would rather hunt it myself.
I tilt my head but don't reach out.
A jungle pterosaur with thin wings.
You hit my wing.

lines.zh: 我的翼尖擦到树，飞歪了一点。
lines.en: A wingtip clipped a tree and I veered.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又找回平衡。
lines.en: I tilt, then find my balance again.
My membrane is thin.

lines.zh: 我擦着你的帽檐飞过去。
lines.en: I skim past the brim of your hat.
I beat my wings elsewhere.
My claws grip your shoulder.
I did not mean to scratch.
The wind pushes us apart.
I land on the rock again.
There are other wings in the sky.
We circle in the same current.
Neither of us calls.
Two shadows pass over the canopy.
She flies higher than I do.
I climb after her.

lines.zh: 两只头冠在气流里并排。
lines.en: Two crests ride the wind side by side.
Then apart.
We land on different rocks.
I test the weight before taking off.
I hold it in my beak.
This is not too heavy.
I fly to the rock and set it down.
It nearly fell.
It's too heavy for me to carry.
I do not take what is not meat.
I flip it over with my beak.
I hook it up with a hind claw.
You dropped it; I do not pick it up for you.
I land on a treetop, crest forward.
I launch from the rock.

lines.zh: 丛林上方，我数着你的步。
lines.en: Above the jungle, I count your steps.
You cannot reach me even looking up.

lines.zh: 我贴着树冠滑到你的侧后方。
lines.en: I glide along the canopy to your flank.
I dive at your head.
You swing your arm.
I climb again.
I come around behind.

lines.zh: 我在你头顶绕第二圈了。
lines.en: This is my second circle over your head.

lines.zh: 我的翅影从你头顶掠过。
lines.en: My wing shadow sweeps over your head.

lines.zh: 我的翼膜切开了林间的光。
lines.en: My wing membrane slices the forest light.
I stay above you.
My shadow sweeps over you.

lines.zh: 你不看我的时候我下压。
lines.en: I drop when you are not looking.
You look up and I climb.
I shift between the trees.
You are at the cliff edge.
I come from behind.
You turn.
I circle.
I drop a little more.
The wind hides my sound.
You cannot keep your footing.
I fold my wings and dive straight down.
Down.
I strike from the air.
My claws rake your shoulder.
My beak jabs your head.
My wing slaps your face.
That grip did not hold.

lines.zh: 我从侧面掠过，翅膀先到。
lines.en: I sweep in from the side, wings first.
You raise an arm to block.
My claws extend again.
You back to the rock's edge.
Your shoulder is bleeding.
I land before you.
I launch from the ridge.

lines.zh: 我的翼第一次完全展开。
lines.en: My wings spread fully for the first time.
The tropical wind holds me up.
I land in a tall tree.

lines.zh: 这片林子和山里都有我。
lines.en: I live in these woods and hills.
I call out to test my voice.
My kind are far off.
I look down at the green.
I beat forward.
My shadow slides over the canopy.

lines.zh: 我找到一股上升的气流。
lines.en: I find a rising current.
I circle in it twice.
I head higher.
I open my beak and the wind pours in.
I begin patrolling this sky.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翼膜，我赶紧拍灭。
lines.en: Fire catches my membrane and I beat it out.

lines.zh: 我摔到树下，翼折了一角。
lines.en: I fall under the tree with a wing bent.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，我拼命拍翅。
lines.en: Water presses me down and I beat my wings hard.

lines.zh: 一阵光打来，我眼睛发花。
lines.en: A flash of magic blinds me briefly.
I have not caught anything in a long while.
Lightning bursts beside me.
